title: On Deterministic Optimal Mechanisms in a Two-Item Setting for Distributions with Nondecreasing Density
abstract: arXiv:2608.22371v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Consider the problem of designing a revenue-optimal auction mechanism when two heterogeneous items are sold to a single buyer having independent valuations over the items. The distributions of the buyer's valuation for the items are assumed to have densities that are positive, nondecreasing, and continuously differentiable on their support sets $[c_i,c_i+b_i]$ in the positive axis. I prove that the optimal mechanism is deterministic if at least one of the minimum valuations (i.e., either $c_1$ or $c_2$) is sufficiently high. I provide a method to calculate the threshold of $(c_1,c_2)$ beyond which the optimal mechanism is deterministic. I also provide a sufficient condition on the distributions of buyer's valuations for which the individual sale mechanism is optimal.   I show that when $c_1$ is low and $c_2$ is high, it is optimal for the seller to sell item $2$ at the minimum valuation $c_2$, thus effectively reducing the problem to f

translated_title: 双物品设置中非递减密度分布下的确定性最优机制研究
translated_abstract: 考虑设计收入最优拍卖机制的问题，其中两种异质物品出售给一个对物品具有独立估值的单一买家。假设买家对物品的估值分布在其支撑集$[c_i,c_i+b_i]$上具有正的、非递减且连续可微的密度函数。我证明，如果至少一个最小估值（即$c_1$或$c_2$）足够高，则最优机制是确定性的。我提供了一种计算$(c_1,c_2)$阈值的方法，超过该阈值后最优机制即为确定性的。我还提供了买家估值分布的充分条件，使得单独销售机制是最优的。我表明，当$c_1$较低且$c_2$较高时，卖方以最低估值$c_2$出售物品2是最优的，从而有效地将问题简化为单物品情形。
tldr: 本文证明了在双物品拍卖中，当至少一个最低估值足够高时，最优机制是确定性的，并提供了阈值计算方法和单独销售最优的充分条件。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that in two-item auctions, the optimal mechanism is deterministic when at least one minimum valuation is sufficiently high, and provides threshold calculation methods and sufficient conditions for individual sale optimality.
